results.title: Finite-arm pseudo-regret decomposition
results.informal: Finite-horizon pseudo-regret equals the sum over arms of each gap multiplied by its pull count.

results.title: Generated-history conditional sub-Gaussian reward law
results.informal: A selected successor reward on the canonical generated trajectory inherits the centered conditional MGF bound supplied by its step kernel.

results.title: Finite-index geometric all-time confidence union
results.informal: If every index in a nonempty finite family receives an equal geometric confidence share at every time, the outer measure of any time-index failure is at most the total confidence budget.
missing: Each ETC, UCB, or RL consumer must still supply its per-time, per-index tail events and model-specific law assumptions.

results.title: Generated finite-arm empirical-mean all-time confidence
results.informal: On one canonical generated action/reward trajectory, every finite arm and every positive successor horizon obeys the existing random-pull-count empirical-mean radius outside an event of outer measure at most the total geometric confidence budget.
missing: The ordinary-UCB chapter uses its exact finite-arm/time confidence producer. A fixed-policy anytime UCB consumer for this stronger geometric event remains a separate extension.

results.title: Generated finite-arm telescoping all-time empirical-mean confidence
results.informal: On one canonical generated action/reward trajectory, every finite arm and positive successor horizon obeys the existing random-pull-count empirical-mean radius at share delta/((n+1)(n+2))/|A| outside an event of outer measure at most delta.

results.title: Fixed-policy telescoping anytime UCB confidence and regret
results.informal: One horizon-free scheduled UCB policy uses the telescoping per-round confidence share on its own generated finite history. On the same canonical action/reward trajectory measure, one all-time confidence event controls every positive-gap arm at every finite horizon, and each finite horizon has an explicit expected pseudo-regret bound.
missing: The finite-time expectation keeps the explicit T times delta failure contribution; fixed-delta expected-average consistency is not claimed.
The compiled bounded KL-UCB extension is mapped separately; literal pinned-LML identity remains cross-toolchain work.

results.title: Probability interfaces used by canonical ETC and ordinary UCB
results.informal: The generated-history law, conditional sub-Gaussian MGF, and finite-arm/time empirical-mean event actually required by the scoped ETC and horizon-indexed UCB routes compile through one external Book Map canary; the reusable countable adapter is exposed separately.

results.title: Canonical sub-Gaussian ETC expected regret
results.informal: The generated ETC policy under finite-arm sub-Gaussian reward laws satisfies the explicit exploration-plus-wrong-commit expected pseudo-regret bound.

results.title: Canonical Rat ETC least-encoded tie rule
results.informal: The Rat commit oracle used by the measurable generated ETC policy is Mathlib's first-occurrence argmax on Fin K, hence chooses the least encoded arm among tied maxima.

results.title: Local ETC endpoint aligned with the LML theorem card
results.informal: The local canonical ETC chapter route compiles; direct identity with the pinned LML declaration remains a separate cross-toolchain theorem-card route and is not claimed here.
missing: Direct imported-LML symbol and toolchain identity remains cross-toolchain work.

results.title: Finite-arm sub-Gaussian UCB gap-sum bound
results.informal: The generated selected-policy UCB action satisfies a textbook-shaped Real pseudo-regret gap-sum bound, including the zero-proxy case.

results.title: Finite-arm UCB expected-average consistency
results.informal: For the compiled finite-arm sub-Gaussian source, expected pseudo-regret divided by the horizon tends to zero.

results.title: Canonical horizon-indexed UCB confidence-to-consistency chain
results.informal: For each explicit horizon and confidence budget, one generated pair-trajectory family carries the finite-arm/time confidence event through large-gap and pull-count bounds to finite-arm expected pseudo-regret; the scheduled family has vanishing expected average regret.
missing: This is a horizon-indexed policy family, not a single fixed-policy anytime UCB theorem.

results.title: Pinned LML UCB theorem-card port
results.informal: Local ordinary-UCB and Real arm-stream one-policy results compile; only literal identity with the pinned upstream declaration remains a separate theorem-card/cross-toolchain gate.
missing: Direct imported-LML symbol and toolchain identity remain cross-toolchain work; the local expected pull-count ledger is already compiled.
Do not treat the upstream theorem card as a local proof term.

results.informal: ABRL has compiled local ETC/UCB theorems shaped against the pinned LeanMachineLearning cards, but it does not import or consume the actual upstream Bandits.ETC.regret_le or Bandits.UCB.regret_le declarations.

results.title: Logarithmic elliptical-potential inequality
results.informal: Clipped inverse-Gram quadratic widths are bounded by a dimension-scaled log-determinant growth term.

results.title: Conditional-MGF to ridge confidence ellipsoid
results.informal: The finite-dimensional conditional-MGF and Gaussian-mixture route controls the ridge-estimation error in the regularized matrix norm.

results.title: Measurable horizon-free optimistic policy
results.informal: A strict-fold finite-action selector turns ridge estimates and scheduled confidence radii into one measurable history algorithm without a terminal horizon parameter.

results.title: One-policy all-time OFUL confidence
results.informal: A telescoping confidence-budget schedule controls one countable failure event for the generated scalar-ridge policy at every deterministic horizon.

results.title: One-policy all-horizon OFUL pseudo-regret
results.informal: On the same canonical trajectory generated by the horizon-free telescoping policy, one outer-measure event controls the explicit pseudo-regret bound for every finite horizon.

results.title: Fixed-model OFUL expected-average consistency
results.informal: For the separate horizon-indexed fixed-model policy family, the canonical expected pseudo-regret bound is little-o of the horizon, so the corresponding expected average tends to zero.

results.title: Bounded stopping-time OFUL expected regret
results.informal: For the same horizon-free telescoping generated policy, any stopping time bounded by a deterministic horizon has nonnegative expected stopped pseudo-regret bounded by the endpoint budget plus the explicit delta-weighted envelope.

results.title: Square-integrable random-horizon OFUL expected regret
results.informal: Under an explicit square-integrable finite stopping-time contract, the stopped high-probability pseudo-regret is integrable and receives a second-moment-controlled expectation bound.

results.title: Posterior kernel equals the conditional environment law
results.informal: When the observed environment-history pair has the canonical prior-likelihood joint law, the canonical posterior kernel is almost everywhere the conditional distribution of the environment given history.

results.title: Canonical one-step probability matching
results.informal: Sampling an environment from the canonical posterior and applying the measurable best-action selector gives the same conditional action law as the posterior best action.

results.title: Probability matching on the actual recursive trajectory
results.informal: For every round, the successor action on the recursively generated Thompson trajectory conditioned on its own finite history has the posterior-best-action conditional law.

results.title: Bayesian regret and clipped-UCB decomposition
results.informal: Probability matching transports finite-history scores so generated comparator-relative mean regret splits exactly into selector and selected-action clipped-score terms; it becomes Bayesian regret when the selector is mean-optimal.

results.title: Generated rewards align with the stationary latent arm stream
results.informal: The actual recursive trajectory reward coordinates agree almost everywhere with the next-unused-coordinate reward read from the selected arm's latent stream.

results.title: Stationary latent-arm-stream Thompson regret
results.informal: Under the explicit pointwise mean-optimal selector, stationary Markov, bounded-mean, and centered sub-Gaussian contracts, the canonical generated Thompson trajectory satisfies E[R_n^Bayes] <= (2K+1)(u-l)+8 sqrt(sigma^2 K n log n).

results.title: General Thompson/LML Bayesian port
results.informal: The stationary local endpoint is complete, but posterior-law producers outside that model and exact upstream compatibility remain separate obligations.
missing: Add posterior-law producers for broader models.
Close the exact upstream compatibility gate.

results.title: Tuned expected EXP3 regret
results.informal: The generated predictable EXP3 process satisfies an explicit square-root expected-regret bound.

results.title: Per-horizon best-arm realized high-probability EXP3
results.informal: For each supplied positive horizon, finite comparator aggregation gives the generated horizon-tuned EXP3 law a best-supported-arm realized-regret tail; changing the horizon changes the parameters and law.
missing: This is not one horizon-free policy with a simultaneous confidence event over all horizons.

results.title: Countable scheduled quadratic fixed-MGF tail
results.informal: A countable union of indexwise deviation-and-variance events is controlled by the sum of their confidence shares and hence by a caller-supplied total budget.

results.title: All-positive-prefix EXP3 predictable-variance tail
results.informal: On one generated EXP3 trajectory law, geometric confidence shares control the joint selected-loss deviation and predictable-variance failures over every positive prefix by one outer budget.

results.title: All-positive-prefix EXP3 realized-deviation tail
results.informal: On one fixed generated EXP3 process, the realized selected loss minus its predictable counterpart stays below its geometrically scheduled radius at every positive prefix outside one failure event of outer mass at most delta.

results.title: All-positive-prefix EXP3 predictable-regret tail
results.informal: For one fixed generated EXP3 process and one supported comparator, every positive-prefix predictable-regret failure is covered by a single geometrically budgeted event.

results.title: All-positive-prefix EXP3 realized-regret tail
results.informal: For one generated EXP3 process and one supported comparator, the realized selected-loss regret at every positive prefix is controlled by the sum of the predictable-regret and realized-deviation schedules outside one event of outer mass at most delta.
missing: The process parameters eta and gamma and the comparator are fixed across prefixes.
The theorem is not a horizon-varying tuned sublinear all-time guarantee, a best-arm minimum, or an ideal EXP3.P theorem.

results.title: Sparse-loss all-horizon high-probability EXP3
results.informal: The best-arm realized-regret tail is controlled with the supplied sparsity-failure probability left explicit.

results.title: Finite-arm IID half-Tsallis logarithmic regret
results.informal: IID probability arm laws with exact model means and positive non-best gaps yield a logarithmic reciprocal-gap regret bound.

results.title: History-adaptive expected-corruption all-regimes bound
results.informal: A measurable predictable corruption model receives an internally selected refined or logarithmic regret bound.

results.title: Nonidentical drifting-mean dynamic regret
results.informal: Predictable-environment regret to the actual moving best arm is bounded by the fixed-comparator route plus an explicit mean-drift penalty.

results.title: Generated oracle-restart switch-count dynamic regret
results.informal: A change-point schedule built from population-mean switches generates a single restart trajectory whose expected dynamic regret is bounded by the square-root switch-count rate under the route's support assumptions.

results.title: Finite-horizon MDP and Bellman interface
results.informal: Finite-horizon MDP data, measurable Markov policies, recursive value functions, optimal Bellman operators, and an attaining optimal policy are formalized locally.

results.title: Expected regret as an occupancy Bellman gap
results.informal: A Markov policy's expected regret equals the occupancy-weighted Bellman optimality gap and is nonnegative; the optimal policy has zero regret.

results.title: Adaptive realized behavior-regret consistency
results.informal: With the explicit path-support, bounded-mean, sub-Gaussian, scheduling, and Standard Borel contracts, both the failure budget and average realized behavior-regret envelope tend to zero across windows.

results.title: Inverse-sqrt hittingAfter is a square-integrable finite stopping time
results.informal: For each fixed threshold index and horizon greater than four, the genuine uncapped Mathlib hittingAfter has an L2 round count under the exact generated causal source.

results.title: Stopped realized behavior regret is integrable and below its hit threshold in expectation
results.informal: For every fixed inverse-sqrt threshold index and horizon greater than four, the exact average realized behavior-regret process stopped at the uncapped hit is integrable and its integral is at most that threshold.

results.title: Generated adaptive cumulative Hoeffding UCBVI-CH chain
results.informal: One generated adaptive process now carries exact aggregate transition numerators and visit denominators, a previous-Q clipped recurrent planner, a strict-prefix measurable policy, joint same-source singleton-Bernstein and optimal-tail confidence, Bellman optimism, raw generated episode pseudo-regret, actual-count charge summation, and a generated-filtration Bellman martingale.

results.title: Canonical known-reward Hoeffding UCBVI-CH terminals
results.informal: On the recurrent source's own trajectory measure, the probability that raw K-episode policy-value pseudo-regret exceeds 20 H sqrt(H) L sqrt(S A K) + 250 H^2 S^2 A L^2 is at most delta. The matching integrable expectation is at most that bound plus K H delta.

results.title: Budget-exhaustion stopping time
results.informal: An adapted natural-valued spending process reaches a fixed budget at a stopping time.

results.title: Bandits-with-knapsacks regret theorem
results.informal: Stopping-time and several positive-cost budget adapters compile, but there is no full resource process, feasibility invariant, primal-dual comparison, and BwK regret theorem.

results.title: Generated bounded-reward KL-UCB confidence and regret
results.informal: One horizon-free measurable policy uses the actual Bernoulli-KL confidence-set supremum on its generated reward history. On the same canonical trajectory measure, a telescoping all-time confidence event controls every positive-gap arm at every finite horizon and yields a conservative finite-time expected pseudo-regret bound.

results.title: Chapter 13 lower-bound semantic and deterministic spine
results.informal: The Chapter 13 conversion window compiles explicit ENNReal worst-case/minimax semantics, a source-shaped least-explored alternative-arm theorem from the exact expected pull budget, and quantitative deterministic two-environment regret algebra whose cross-law pull discrepancy remains a visible error premise.

results.title: Theorem 13.1 Gaussian finite-arm minimax lower bound
results.informal: For k-armed unit-variance Gaussian bandits with mean vectors in the unit cube, the source states a universal-constant minimax lower bound of order sqrt(k n) for k greater than one and n at least k; the source defers the proof to Chapter 15 and BanditRLlib makes no local compiled-terminal claim yet.
